title: assure.GitHubAttestations
description: Writes the proof run predicate outside the repository, for the proof run workflow to upload and for its attest job, which runs no code of the repository, to sign with actions/attest. Reads the run, the job's workflow identity and the trusted signer, the repository's proof-run.yml workflow, from the job's environment. Fetches the attestations GitHub keeps for a commit from its REST API by SubjectDigest of the commit, with the job's token, and only moves bytes: the Sigstore check in VerifyAttestation decides.

title: delivery.Konflux
description: Not written yet. At apply it renders the Pipelines-as-Code PipelineRun under .tekton/ with the standard pipeline bundle and the STEGO checks task, each by the sha256 digest the ci-pipeline component gives, with the hermetic build and the gomod prefetch on, and it refuses a tag, a branch, a short SHA or a task the registry does not name. In the pipeline, stego delivery check pulls the image by digest only, through appbuild's bounded registry transport (explicit CA, named origins, size limits, no ambient credential), verifies the build task's Tekton Chains signature against the public key digest the ci-pipeline component names, refuses any other signer, and writes the check record as a Tekton result for Chains to attest. It calls no Konflux or Tekton API and holds no credential beyond the pull credential the pipeline gives it.

title: delivery.ArgoCD
description: Not written yet. It sends nothing to Argo CD: it renders the ApplicationSet in the argoproj.io/v1alpha1 schema with only the fields STEGO owns (the set's name, the template's project and the source path of the base, and the git-files generator over the platform's environment files path) into deploy/argocd/applicationset.yaml, and Argo CD pulls the file from git. It refuses to render a destination, a namespace, a sync policy, an overlay path or an image digest, which each environment file supplies, and it decodes its own output strictly before the file enters the plan. It holds no Argo CD credential and reads no sync status; the platform's flow gates an environment file with stego env check before Argo CD applies it.
